signoffNote: DRAFT starter rules. Each rule says: when TRIGGER is true for a case, the structured plan must contain every REQUIRES element. A rule never says what the answer is, only that the question must be addressed. Not yet reviewed by a clinician (docs/CLINICAL_SIGNOFF_CHECKLIST.md).

triggerTypes.cd4Below: CD4 (structured value, or a single unambiguous 'CD4 <n>' in the text) is below value
triggerTypes.text: any pattern matches the case text (negated spans ignored)
triggerTypes.plan: any pattern matches the plan's management/investigation/treatment text (checked after generation only)
triggerTypes.predicate: named built-in: hlhSuspected | hypotension | hyponatraemia | alteredConsciousness | suspectedSepsis | onTbTreatment

rules.title: Advanced HIV disease (CD4 < 200)
sources: SA HIV Clinicians Society adult ART guideline

requires.description: an explicit ART timing decision in timingDecisions (start now / defer / switch, with the reason and what must be excluded first, for example cryptococcal or TB meningitis)
cotrimoxazole prophylaxis addressed in prophylaxis (indicated, or why not)
TB status addressed (excluded, probable, or on treatment) with the tests used
cryptococcal antigen status addressed (result, or ordered)
urine LAM status addressed (result, or ordered)

rules.title: Patient is already on TB treatment
sources: South African National TB Management Guidelines (NDoH)

requires.description: an explicit continue / stop / modify decision for the existing TB treatment, with the reason, in existingTreatmentDecisions

rules.title: Suspected haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH)
sources: Henter et al. HLH-2004 diagnostic criteria

requires.description: bone marrow aspirate/trephine (haemophagocytosis, and culture/histology for infection or malignancy) in investigations
a search for the trigger (infection, malignancy, autoimmune) since HLH is secondary until proven otherwise

rules.title: Amphotericin is being recommended
sources: SA HIV Clinicians Society cryptococcal/OI guidance
WHO guidelines on cryptococcal disease and histoplasmosis in people with HIV

requires.description: formulation choice (liposomal vs deoxycholate) justified against renal function and availability

rules.title: Confusion or reduced GCS
sources: SA Standard Treatment Guidelines and EML (Hospital Level)
SA HIV Clinicians Society OI guidance

requires.description: lumbar puncture considered (done, or why deferred, for example imaging first)

rules.title: Hypotension with hyponatraemia
sources: Society for Endocrinology emergency guidance on adrenal crisis (adapt to SA STG)

requires.description: adrenal insufficiency considered: random/baseline cortisol (ideally before steroids) and whether to give empirical hydrocortisone

rules.title: Suspected sepsis
sources: Surviving Sepsis Campaign (adapt to SA STG)

requires.description: blood cultures before antimicrobials where this does not delay treatment
lactate measured (needed to judge Sepsis-3 shock criteria)
